claims.summary: Currency banknotes are made of cotton-rag substrate and contain no electronic microchips, antennas, or GPS transmitters.
claims.why_this_result: GPS technology requires power sources (batteries), satellite receivers, and radio antennas, none of which physically fit or function in paper banknotes.

claims.summary: Entering your ATM PIN in reverse does not alert police or dispense cash while locking the machine.
claims.why_this_result: Banking security systems simply register an incorrect PIN attempt and decline the transaction after 3 tries; reverse-PIN alert does not exist.
